node.title: Full-column-rank rate-half Hankel branch
node.statement: For r<(n-k)/2, if the (n-k-r) by (r+1) syndrome Hankel pencil has generic column rank r+1, then a fixed nonzero maximal minor of degree at most r+1 contains every slope with a nonzero kernel. Hence at most r+1 slopes carry a domain-split locator, proving the required far-CA bound in this branch. In the first official transition, only generically rank-deficient pencils remain; at the final CA-only block r=(n-k)/2, deficiency is forced by matrix dimensions.
